req.title: Include Content-Length on echo responses
req.statement: The system shall include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length on echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the Content-Length header must be included in the response of echo endpoints, matching the byte length of the response body. This ensures clients can correctly interpret the size of the response. The tests will verify this behavior across different HTTP methods, including positive, negative, and boundary cases.

tests.name: test_content_length_positive
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /get endpoint.
expected: The Content-Length header matches the byte length of the response body.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/get')
assert response.status_code == 200
body_length = len(response.data)
assert int(response.headers['Content-Length']) == body_length

tests.name: test_content_length_negative
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to the /post endpoint with malformed data.
expected: The response status code is 400 or 500 indicating an error.
The Content-Length header is not required to match the response body length in error cases.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/post', data='malformed')
assert response.status_code in [400, 500]
try:
    body_length = len(response.data)
    assert int(response.headers['Content-Length']) == body_length
except KeyError:
    pass

tests.name: test_content_length_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a PUT request to the /put endpoint with an empty body.
expected: The Content-Length header is 0, matching the empty response body.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.put('/put', data='')
assert response.status_code == 200
body_length = len(response.data)
assert body_length == 0
assert int(response.headers['Content-Length']) == body_length
